description: Single source of truth for the AD traceability engine. Every node type, edge type, enum value, event name and payload key used anywhere in engine/, web/ or eval/ MUST appear here. tests/test_contract.py fails the build on any key that does not.

Docket.note: Join key between the NPRM spreadsheet and Federal Register final rules. Format FAA-YYYY-NNNN.

NPRM.note: From the AD NPRM spreadsheet. Proposed rule: has comments_due_date, has NO effective_date or amendment.

AD.note: Identity of a final airworthiness directive, e.g. '2026-21-13'. Spans all its revisions.

Revision.note: One Federal Register document. revision_id == fr_document_number. amendment from docket_ids, e.g. '39-23502'. content_sha256/retrieved_at pin exactly which bytes an answer was derived from, so a citation is reproducible after the source changes.

Paragraph.note: paragraph_id format: '{revision_id}#{label}'. char offsets index into Revision.plain_text for exact citation spans.

Rule.note: One applicability condition. source_quote MUST be a verbatim substring of its Paragraph.text. Extracted rules are DRAFTS: review_status defaults to UNREVIEWED and schema validity is not correctness.

Action.note: compliance_basis is an enum; external_ref set when the deadline lives in a document we do not hold.

Aircraft.note: Real records only, from the OpenSky public aircraft database. Fields absent in the source stay null and drive CANNOT_DETERMINE; they are never invented.

ForeignAD.note: Cross-regulator reference, e.g. EASA AD 2025-0208. held=false means we do not have its text.

ServiceBulletin.note: held is always false in this build. Referenced-but-absent documents are a first-class refusal cause.

PROPOSED_BY.note: Links a final rule back to its proposal via shared docket.

NEED_CONFIG.trigger: Rule exists on a field the query did not supply and the fleet record does not hold.

CANNOT_DETERMINE.trigger: Applicability text the extractor could not parse (Rule.operator == 'unparsed').

NO_EVIDENCE.trigger: Top fused retrieval score below threshold.

OUT_OF_SCOPE.trigger: Query plan intent outside AD content, or a model absent from the corpus.

SUPERSEDED.trigger: Asked about a revision that has a newer one. Answer IS still given, with a banner.

EXTERNAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED.trigger: Applicability or compliance time is delegated to a ForeignAD or ServiceBulletin with held=false.

answer_envelope.note: The full shape of a delivered answer. Every field is always present; a field that cannot be filled carries an explicit reason, never silence.

fields.document_stage: one of enums.document_stage - whether this imposes an obligation now
fields.applicability_result: one of enums.decision, or null when no aircraft was resolved
fields.evaluated_conditions: the proof tree: each condition, the aircraft value, the rule value, the outcome, the source quote
fields.revision_status: current / superseded, with the superseding revision when known
fields.citations: claim-level; every sentence carries >=1 citation_id resolved in code
fields.missing_inputs: what the user could supply to resolve a NEED_CONFIG, named exactly
fields.limitations: what this answer does NOT establish, including unheld external documents and unreviewed rules
fields.traversal: one of enums.traversal_outcome, with the references followed and any document that was missing

rules: A citation_id MUST resolve to a Paragraph that was in the retrieved set for this query.
The cited char span MUST be a verbatim substring of that Paragraph.text.

federal_register.note: docket_ids is a structured list carrying 'Docket No. X', 'Amendment 39-N', 'AD YYYY-NN-NN'. Parse from it; never regex the prose for these.

nprm_spreadsheet.path: data/raw/AD Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (AD NPRM).xlsx
nprm_spreadsheet.note: Dates are TEXT in %m/%d/%Y. 323 unique dockets, 99 re-noticed.

opensky_aircraft.note: Follow redirect to s3.opensky-network.org. Real registrations and serial numbers.

invariants: No Rule may be created without a source_quote that is a verbatim substring of its Paragraph.text.
No answer sentence may be shown without >=1 citation_id that resolves to a retrieved Paragraph.
Aircraft fields absent from the source dataset are null and MUST yield CANNOT_DETERMINE, never a guess.
A Revision whose applicability delegates to a ForeignAD or ServiceBulletin with held=false MUST refuse EXTERNAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED rather than infer applicability.
The rules engine, not the LLM, produces every value in enums.decision.
No UI animation may render a result that has not passed verification.
An NPRM is a PROPOSAL and can never be cited as a current legal obligation. Only Revision paragraphs are citable; NPRM text must never enter the citable paragraph index.

Every answer that states a requirement MUST carry the document_stage of the revision it came from. An AD adopted but not yet effective does not yet impose an obligation, and saying so is part of being correct.
